expected.citation: build.sh compiles the unprotected binary with -fno-stack-protector; CHECK_CANARY is blint's rule for a missing stack canary (blint/data/rules.yml)
build.sh links the unprotected binary with -Wl,-z,execstack, so its GNU_STACK segment is executable; CHECK_NX is blint's rule for it (blint/data/rules.yml)
build.sh compiles and links the unprotected binary with -fno-pie -no-pie; CHECK_PIE is blint's rule for a position-dependent executable (blint/data/rules.yml)
build.sh compiles the unprotected binary with -U_FORTIFY_SOURCE at -O0, so src/vulnerable.c:13 calls the unchecked strcpy; CHECK_FORTIFY is blint's rule for it (blint/data/rules.yml)
build.sh links the unprotected binary with -Wl,-z,norelro, so it has no GNU_RELRO segment; CHECK_RELRO is blint's rule for missing RELRO (blint/data/rules.yml)

a binary linked against glibc 2.34 or later imports __libc_start_main@GLIBC_2.34, above the 2.28 baseline_version of blint's CHECK_ABI_FLOOR rule (blint/data/rules.yml); every supported Linux runner has glibc 2.34 or later
the protected build imports __libc_start_main@GLIBC_2.34 too, above the 2.28 baseline_version of CHECK_ABI_FLOOR (blint/data/rules.yml)

forbidden.reason: build.sh compiles the protected build with -fstack-protector-strong -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -fPIE -pie -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now -Wl,-z,noexecstack, so none of the five hardening findings may fire on it
